thread:
leah: Heads-up — weights for llamaX_v0.9 are in s3://redwood-models/onboard/llamaX_v0.9/ (tarball + tokenizer). Quick smoke showed a tokenizer quirk in chat templates: we get an extra <s> token at start which shifts prefix caching. Anyone hit this before?

matt: saw something similar on a community fork. Is the tokenizer using <s> as bos or as an explicit chat-system token?

sruti: I ran a quick encode: `tokenizer.encode('\nHuman: hi\nAssistant:')` returns ids starting with 1 which maps to `<s>`. Config snippet shows `bos_token_id: 1` and `pad_token_id: 0`. But the chat template code also prepends a system token (``<|system|>``) leading to double-bos in some templates.

leah: ah that explains the off-by-one in our KV cache warmup perf test — we saw mismatched cache keys. Can someone confirm the tokenizer.json included in the tarball?

toni: confirm: tokenizer.json is present. I ran `jq '.model.vocab_size' tokenizer.json` — looks normal. But the `special_tokens_map` has `{"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"}` while the chat code expects `"<|system|>"` as system marker.

matt: two quick fixes: (1) update chat-template mapping to treat `<s>` as BOS (safe), (2) add a small migration that strips an initial `<s>` if template already adds a system marker. Which approach do we prefer?

sruti: prefer adding migration + unit test. We want backward compatibility for older tokenizers that used explicit system marker. Also we should add a config validation that ensures `bos_token_id` is not null. I saw one onboarding config with `bos_token_id: null` and that caused our validator to accept it but runtime fails.

leah: agreed. Action items: matt add migration PR for template sanitizer; sruti add config validation (fail if bos_token_id is null or equals pad_token_id); toni update the model manifest to include explicit `chat_system_token` mapping.

matt: I'll push the PR today — small change. Patch will do: in chat_render(), if tokens[0] == bos_id and template_already_has_system: pop(0). Also add a unit test showing both cases.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/test-runner on matt/migration-llamaX passed 1/1 checks.

leah: Also note weights path for anyone running local tests: s3://redwood-models/onboard/llamaX_v0.9/llamaX_v0.9.tar.gz. Use `make local-run MODEL_PATH=s3://...` and `TOKENIZER_PATH=.../tokenizer.json`.

sruti: small snippet I used to repro locally: ```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Human: hi\nAssistant:').tokens)
``` It prints `['<s>', 'Human', ':', ...]` so you can see the extra `<s>`.

toni: added `chat_system_token` to model_manifest.yaml in the s3 folder with value `<|system|>` for clarity.

leah: thanks. Once matt's PR merges and sruti's validator is in, I'll re-run the onboarding pipeline. If we still see cache misses I'll open a perf ticket.

matt: ping me on the PR for quick review, will try to get it out this afternoon. :thumbsup:

sruti: I'll add the validator and a regression test to the onboarding CI job.

leah: perfect — closing the loop here. If anyone hits more weird token mapping cases, drop them in this thread and label `onboard-llamaX`.
